name: DeviceInfoChannels
description: JSON key names for the DeviceInfo payload exchanged over the DEVICE_INFO channel. Both PC and Android must use the exact same key strings — define them here once and generate both sides.

members.name: LAST_SEEN
members.description: Human-readable recency string, e.g. "now", "today", "3 days ago".

members.name: BATTERY_LEVEL
members.description: Battery level as an integer percentage (0–100).

members.name: BATTERY_CHARGING
members.description: Whether the device is currently charging.

members.name: IP
members.description: Last known LAN IP address of the device, used to reconnect.

members.name: PC_NAME
members.description: The human-readable name of the Windows PC.
